results.question: How many trips were there on the day with the highest total fare?
results.sql: SELECT trips FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY total_fare DESC LIMIT 1
results.reference_sql: SELECT trips FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY total_fare DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which pickup zip has the lowest average fare per trip, counting only zips with at least 20 trips in total?
results.sql:
SELECT pickup_zip
FROM gold_daily_zone_stats
GROUP BY pickup_zip
HAVING SUM(trips) >= 20
ORDER BY SUM(total_fare) / SUM(trips) ASC
LIMIT 1
results.reference_sql: SELECT pickup_zip FROM gold_daily_zone_stats GROUP BY pickup_zip HAVING SUM(trips) >= 20 ORDER BY SUM(total_fare) / SUM(trips) ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: On how many days were there more trips than the average daily trip count?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS days FROM gold_daily_summary WHERE trips > (SELECT AVG(trips) FROM gold_daily_summary)
results.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_daily_summary WHERE trips > (SELECT AVG(trips) FROM gold_daily_summary)

results.question: What is the total fare for pickup zip 10001?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS total_fare FROM gold_daily_zone_stats WHERE pickup_zip = 10001
results.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_fare), 2) FROM gold_daily_zone_stats WHERE pickup_zip = 10001

results.question: How many zip-and-day combinations had at least 10 trips?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS combinations FROM gold_daily_zone_stats WHERE trips >= 10
results.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_daily_zone_stats WHERE trips >= 10

results.question: What is the longest average trip duration in minutes recorded for any zip on any day?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(avg_duration_min) AS longest_avg_duration_min FROM gold_daily_zone_stats

results.question: What are the earliest and latest dates in the data?
results.sql: SELECT MIN(pickup_date) AS earliest_date, MAX(pickup_date) AS latest_date FROM gold_daily_summary

results.question: Show the date and number of trips for the first 3 dates in the data.
results.sql: SELECT pickup_date, trips FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY pickup_date ASC LIMIT 3
results.reference_sql: SELECT pickup_date, trips FROM gold_daily_summary ORDER BY pickup_date ASC LIMIT 3
